name: 陸一平
objective:
本課程以統計機器學習的基本理論與方法為主，內容涵蓋監督學習、無監督學習及常見機率模型，協助學生建立完整的機器學習基礎。課程共分為三個部分：

第一部份: 概念介紹與監督學習

第二部份 無監督學習

第三部份 機器學習總結

This course focuses on the fundamental theories and methods of statistical machine learning, covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and common probabilistic models to help students build a comprehensive foundation in machine learning. The course is divided into three parts:

Part 1: Introduction to Concepts and Supervised Learning

Part Two: Unsupervised Learning

Part Three: Summary of Machine Learning
課程進度(1-16週):
第 1 週：統計學習與機器學習概論
Week 1: Introduction to Statistical Learning and Machine Learning

第 2 週：感知機原理、 k-Nearest Neighbor - kNN
Week 2: Perceptron principle、 k-Nearest Neighbor - kNN

第 3 週：單純貝氏法、決策樹
Week 3: Simple Baumer method、Decision Tree

第 4 週：邏輯回歸與最大熵模型
Week 4: Logistic Regression and Maximum Entropy Model

第 5 週：支持向量機、提升方法
Week 5: Support Vector Machine、Improvement methods

第 6 週：EM 演算法
Week 6: EM Algorithm

第 7 週：隱馬可夫模型
Week 7: Hidden Markov Model

第 8 週：條件隨機場
Week 8: Conditional Random Fields

第 9 週：無監督學習概論
Week 9: Introduction to Unsupervised Learning

第 10 週：聚類方法
Week 10: Clustering methods

第 11 週：奇異值分解、主成分分析
Week 11: Singular Value Decomposition、Principal component analysis

潛在語意分析 與 機率潛在語意分析 (自行閱讀) 
Latent semantic analysis and probabilistic latent semantic analysis (read on your own)

第 12 週：馬可夫鏈蒙地卡羅法
Week 12: Markov chain Monte Carlo method

第 13 週：潛在狄利克雷分配
Week 13: Potential Dirichlet Allocation

第 14 週：PageRank 演算法
Week 14: PageRank Algorithm

第 15 週：機器學習總結
Week 15: Machine Learning Summary

第 16 週：期末報告
Week 16:  Final Report
